title.tc: 三個常見階段：可重疊，不是固定步驟
title.en: Three common stages: overlapping, not a fixed sequence

meaning.tc: 把犯罪現金放入金融體系。
meaning.en: Introduce criminal cash into the financial system.

meaning.tc: 用多層複雜交易掩藏來源、截斷審計線索及提供匿名性。
meaning.en: Use complex layers of transactions to disguise origin, obscure the audit trail and provide anonymity.

meaning.tc: 使犯罪財富重新出現為貌似合法的資產或業務收益。
meaning.en: Return criminal wealth as apparently legitimate assets or business proceeds.

note.tc: 三個階段是理解典型模式的工具，實際交易可同時涉及多個階段。匯款或兌換業務可能協助存放及分層，交易有商業外觀也不表示資金合法。
note.en: The stages explain typical patterns; actual transactions can overlap them. Remittance and exchange can facilitate placement and layering, and a commercial appearance does not establish legitimacy.

title.tc: ML、TF及PF：不要只看資金來源
title.en: ML, TF and PF: origin is not the only concern

rows.tc: 洗錢（ML）
rows.en: Money laundering (ML)

rows.tc: 犯罪得益的來源被掩飾。
rows.en: Disguises the criminal origin of proceeds.

rows.tc: 財產可全部／部分、直接／間接代表得益；境外行為若在港會屬可公訴罪行也可涵蓋。
rows.en: Property may represent proceeds wholly/partly, directly/indirectly; overseas conduct that would be indictable in Hong Kong may be covered.

rows.tc: 恐怖分子資金籌集（TF）
rows.en: Terrorist financing (TF)

rows.tc: 合法或非法來源均可能涉及；看用途、對象及法定心理要素。
rows.en: Lawful or unlawful funds may be involved; purpose, recipient and statutory mental elements matter.

rows.tc: 供恐怖行為使用的財產須有意圖或知情，不必實際使用；向恐怖分子／聯繫者提供或為其籌集時，知道或罔顧對方身分均可涵蓋。
rows.en: Property for terrorist acts requires intent/knowledge, not actual use. Relevant provision/collection for a terrorist/associate covers knowledge or recklessness about that status.

rows.tc: 擴散融資（PF）
rows.en: Proliferation financing (PF)

rows.tc: 服務可能協助大規模毀滅武器及其運載方式。
rows.en: Services may assist WMD and their means of delivery.

rows.tc: 有合理理由相信或懷疑服務可能涉及PF便可能觸犯第526章；適用制裁禁令另須遵守。
rows.en: Cap.526 covers belief or suspicion on reasonable grounds that services may be connected to PF; applicable sanctions prohibitions also apply.

title.tc: 風險名單與制裁名單
title.en: Risk lists and sanctions lists

rows.tc: FATF：呼籲採取行動
rows.en: FATF: call for action

rows.tc: 相稱的加強盡職審查；指定情況另有反制措施。
rows.en: Proportionate EDD; countermeasures in specified cases.

rows.tc: 按有關聲明及海關通函區分；具體地區名單保留通函日期，不能當作永久名單。
rows.en: Distinguish the applicable statement/circular. Country lists are dated snapshots, not permanent lists.

rows.tc: FATF：加強監察
rows.en: FATF: increased monitoring

rows.tc: 納入客戶整體風險評估。
rows.en: Factor into the overall customer risk assessment.

rows.tc: 單憑列名不會自動令每宗客戶關係必須EDD。
rows.en: Listing alone does not automatically require EDD for every customer relationship.

rows.tc: 受指定人士／實體制裁
rows.en: Designated-person/entity sanctions

rows.tc: 依法凍結及禁止提供／處理資產等。
rows.en: Statutory freezing and prohibitions on availability/dealing.

rows.tc: 不能用「低風險」取代法定禁止；只有適用豁免／有效特許才可在其範圍內行事。
rows.en: A low-risk rating does not override a prohibition; only act within applicable exemptions/valid licences.

rows.en: Licensee ceases all / specified-premises business

rows.en: This is s.41 cessation; s.34 revocation/suspension surrender follows the notice, not automatically seven days.

not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
3 times the amount of the profit gained

title.tc: 第21條與第43條：兩套罰款上限
title.en: Sections 21 and 43: two penalty ceilings

rows.tc: 第21條
rows.en: Section 21

rows.tc: 最高為HK$10,000,000與所得利益／避免成本3倍，兩者較大者。
rows.en: Up to the greater of HK$10 million and three times profit gained / costs avoided.

rows.tc: 針對指明CDD／紀錄等違規；補救期限後持續不遵從命令，可另處最高每日HK$100,000。
rows.en: Specified CDD/record-related contraventions; continued non-compliance after the remedial deadline can attract up to HK$100,000 daily.

rows.tc: 第43條
rows.en: Section 43
Up to HK$1 million.

rows.tc: 發牌紀律處分；補救期限後持續不遵從命令，可另處最高每日HK$10,000。
rows.en: Licensing discipline; continued non-compliance after the remedial deadline can attract up to HK$10,000 daily.

refs.anchor: 3 times the amount of the profit gained

note.tc: 兩者均是上限而非固定罰款；須依程序給予陳詞機會。罰款通常自決定生效起30日內或獲准較長期間繳付。
note.en: Both are ceilings, not fixed fines, and hearing procedures apply. Fines normally fall due within 30 days after the decision takes effect, or a longer allowed period.

title.en: Similar amounts, different legal purposes

rows.tc: MSO的非經常交易（一般非電傳）
rows.en: MSO occasional transaction (general non-wire)

rows.tc:
≥ HK$120,000
等於亦包括
rows.en:
≥ HK$120,000
At least HK$120,000; includes equality.

rows.en: CDD before execution

rows.tc: 沒有業務關係；單次或看來相連操作合併。建立關係、懷疑或資料疑問另有不限金額觸發。
rows.en: No business relationship; aggregate apparently linked operations. Relationship, suspicion and information doubts separately trigger CDD regardless of amount.

rows.tc: 金融機構非經常電傳／VA轉移
rows.en: FI occasional wire / VA transfer

rows.tc: 執行前CDD
rows.en: CDD before execution

rows.en: Aggregate linked operations; below HK$8,000 wire information duties remain. Licensed-VASP non-transfer transactions have a separate HK$8,000 rule, not a universal MSO rule.

rows.tc: 非電傳外匯款發款人
rows.en: Non-wire outward-remittance originator

rows.tc: 第13條核實及紀錄
rows.en: Section 13 verification and records

rows.tc: 指定識別文件及資料；不把所有一般交易CDD門檻改成8,000元。
rows.en: Use specified identity documents and records; this does not lower the general CDD threshold for every transaction.

rows.tc: 跨境實體現金類物品
rows.en: Cross-boundary physical CBNIs

rows.tc:
> HK$120,000
恰好不包括
rows.en:

Aggregate value above HK$120,000; equality excluded.

rows.tc: 第629章申報／披露制度
rows.en: Cap.629 declaration / disclosure regime

rows.tc: 按旅客／貨物、管有、批次及豁除判斷；與CDD是兩套制度。
rows.en: Apply traveller/cargo routes, possession, batches and exclusions; this is a separate regime from CDD.

rows.tc: 兌換顧客交付的款額
rows.en: Amount tendered by exchange customer

rows.tc:
> HK$100,000
恰好不豁除
rows.en:

More than HK$100,000; equality not excluded.

rows.tc: 不適用第34章
rows.en: Cap.34 monetary exclusion

rows.tc: 恰好100,000元仍在金額範圍，其他豁除另論；不是AMLO的CDD豁免。
rows.en: Exactly HK$100,000 remains within monetary scope, subject to other exclusions; this is not an AMLO CDD exemption.

title.tc: 實益擁有人：超過25%與控制權
title.en: Beneficial owners: more than 25% and control

rows.tc: 公司
rows.en: Corporation

rows.tc: 超過25%股本或大會投票權；或最終控制管理。
rows.en: More than 25% share capital or general-meeting votes; or ultimate management control.

rows.tc: 直接／間接均計；正好25%本身不符合擁有權門檻，仍須檢查控制。也包括交易為其進行的人。
rows.en: Direct/indirect interests count. Exactly 25% alone misses the ownership threshold; still examine control and persons on whose behalf transactions occur.

rows.tc: 合夥
rows.en: Partnership

rows.tc: 超過25%資本／利潤或投票權；或最終控制管理。
rows.en: More than 25% capital/profit or voting rights; or ultimate management control.

rows.tc: 不能只找股份，或因未找到超過25%的人便停止查控制權。
rows.en: Do not search only for shares or stop examining control when no person exceeds 25%.

rows.tc: 信託
rows.en: Trust

rows.tc: 享有信託財產既得權益的受益人／受益人類別；授予人、受託人、保護人／執行人；最終控制的自然人。
rows.en: Beneficiaries/classes with vested interests in trust property; settlors, trustees, protectors/enforcers; individuals with ultimate control.

rows.tc: 信託不能套用公司的25%門檻；既得權益可為將來享有或可被終止的權益，依定義判斷。
rows.en: Do not apply the corporate 25% threshold to trusts; vested interests can include future or defeasible interests under the definition.

title.tc: 拒絕未完成交易與撤銷已完成交易

title.tc: 機構風險與客戶風險
title.en: Institutional risk and customer risk

rows.tc: 機構層面
rows.en: Institutional level

rows.tc: 評估整個業務暴露的風險，設計制度及資源。
rows.en: Assess business-wide exposure to shape systems and resources.

rows.tc: 客戶、地區、產品／服務／交易、渠道及其他風險均須考慮；規模小可簡化方法，不是免評估。
rows.en: Consider customer, country, product/service/transaction, channel and other risks. A small business may use a simpler method, not omit assessment.

rows.tc: 客戶層面
rows.en: Customer level

rows.tc: 判定個別客戶／關係的CDD及持續監察程度。
rows.en: Set CDD and ongoing-monitoring intensity for the individual customer/relationship.

rows.tc: 初期評估決定審查程度，統合CDD資料後定案，並隨風險改變更新；不能只靠國籍或單一分數。
rows.en: Initial assessment sets CDD extent; finalise holistically with CDD information and update as risk changes, not solely by nationality or one score.

title.tc: 兩年、每年、事前：覆核節奏不可互換
title.en: Two-yearly, annual, before launch: do not interchange review clocks

rows.tc: 機構風險評估
rows.en: Institutional risk assessment

rows.tc: 每兩年及重大觸發事件時。
rows.en: Every two years and upon material triggers.

rows.tc: 新客戶組別／渠道／產品、重大流程／對手改變或嚴重違規可觸發；不是未滿兩年便毋須重做。
rows.en: New segments/channels/products, material process/counterparty changes or significant breaches may trigger review before two years.

rows.tc: 新產品／渠道／科技
rows.en: New products / channels / technology

rows.tc: 推出或使用前先評估並緩解風險。
rows.en: Assess and mitigate before launch/use.

rows.tc: 包括現有產品使用新／發展中科技；不是只適用全新產品。
rows.en: Includes new/developing technology for existing products, not only entirely new products.

rows.tc: 高風險客戶CDD資料
rows.en: High-risk customer CDD records

rows.tc: 至少每年覆核，另按事件更新。
rows.en: Review at least annually, with event-driven updates.

rows.tc: 持續監察並非每年才做一次；一般客戶不因這項規則一律有相同年度週期。
rows.en: Ongoing monitoring is not an annual-only task; this does not impose the same universal annual cycle on every customer.

rows.tc: 獨立審核
rows.en: Independent audit

rows.tc: 定期，頻率／程度按業務及風險。
rows.en: Regular, with frequency/extent based on business and risk.

rows.tc: 沒有所有機構一律每年或每兩年的固定審核期限。
rows.en: No single annual or two-year audit deadline applies universally.

title.tc: 客戶、實益擁有人、代表及關連人士
title.en: Customer, beneficial owner, representative and connected party

rows.tc: 客戶
rows.en: Customer

rows.tc: 與MSO建立關係，或由MSO為其執行交易的一方。
rows.en: Party entering the relationship or for whom the MSO transacts.

rows.tc: 交易第三方通常不自動是本機構客戶；法律實體本身仍須識別及核實。
rows.en: Transaction third parties are not automatically its customers; identify/verify the legal entity itself.

rows.tc: 實益擁有人（BO）
rows.en: Beneficial owner (BO)

rows.tc: 最終擁有／控制客戶，或交易為其進行的人；須按各類定義判斷。
rows.en: Ultimate ownership/control or the person for whom a transaction occurs, under the applicable definition.

rows.tc: 公司／合夥的持股及控制分支指自然人；代他人交易及信託角色不能一概排除法人。
rows.en: Corporate/partnership ownership and control limbs concern individuals; acting-on-behalf and trust roles do not universally exclude legal persons.

rows.tc: 代表人（PPTA）
rows.en: Representative (PPTA)

rows.tc: 替客戶行事的人。
rows.en: Person acting for the customer.

rows.tc: 取得適用識別資料、合理核實及核實授權；不是每名董事／BO都必須親身開戶。
rows.en: Obtain relevant identity data, reasonably verify and check authority; not every director/BO must attend opening.

rows.tc: 關連人士
rows.en: Connected party

rows.tc: 例如董事、合夥人、受託人等適用人士。
rows.en: Applicable directors, partners, trustees and other specified persons.

rows.tc: 須取得姓名；若兼任客戶、BO或PPTA，另按該角色作適用識別／核實，不能只記姓名。
rows.en: Obtain names; overlapping customer, BO or PPTA roles attract their applicable checks, not name collection alone.

refs.anchor: treated a PPTA as the customer
more than 25% of the issued share capital
appropriate measures which are commensurate with the ML/TF risks

title.tc: SOW與SOF：財富與本次資金
title.en: SOW and SOF: accumulated wealth and specific funds

rows.tc: 財富來源（SOW）
rows.en: Source of wealth (SOW)

rows.tc: 整體財富／資產如何累積。
rows.en: How the overall body of wealth/assets was accumulated.

rows.tc: 例如事業、投資及繼承；按風險取得及核對資料，並非每宗都須追溯同一長度歷史。
rows.en: For example business, investment or inheritance; obtain/corroborate proportionately, not an identical historical lookback in every case.

rows.tc: 資金來源（SOF）
rows.en: Source of funds (SOF)

rows.tc: 這次關係／交易的特定資金由甚麼活動產生。
rows.en: The activity generating the specific funds in this relationship/transaction.

rows.tc: 只知道從哪家銀行匯出並不足夠；銀行是傳送渠道，不等於已確立資金的產生來源。
rows.en: The sending bank’s name alone is insufficient; a transmission route does not establish the generating source.

note.tc: 法例要求確立SOW及SOF時，須兩者處理；不是在兩者之間任選一個。措施程度仍須與風險相稱。
note.en: Where law requires establishment of SOW and SOF, address both, not a choice of one; calibrate the extent to risk.

title.tc: PEP類別與加強措施
title.en: PEP categories and enhanced measures

rows.tc: 非香港PEP
rows.en: Non-Hong Kong PEP

rows.tc: 建立／繼續關係前：高級管理層批准、合理確立SOW及SOF、加強持續監察。
rows.en: Before establishment/continuation: senior approval, reasonable SOW and SOF establishment and enhanced ongoing monitoring.

rows.tc: 包括客戶或其BO；並非三選一。現有關係後來才發現PEP身分也須處理。
rows.en: Covers customer/BO; these are not alternatives. Later discovery within an existing relationship also requires action.

rows.tc: 香港／國際組織PEP
rows.en: Hong Kong / international-organisation PEP

rows.tc: 高風險關係須上述全部加強措施。
rows.en: All those enhanced measures for high-risk relationships.

rows.tc: 建立時高風險、後來變高風險，或高風險關係後來發現PEP身分均涵蓋；本地PEP不自動一律高風險。
rows.en: Covers high risk at establishment, later becoming high risk, or PEP discovery in a high-risk relationship. Domestic status is not universally high risk.

rows.tc: 前PEP
rows.en: Former PEP

rows.tc: 離任不會自動取消措施，也沒有通用「過幾年就免」期限。
rows.en: Leaving office does not automatically end measures; there is no universal elapsed-years exemption.

rows.tc: 適當評估剩餘影響等，確定不再高風險並獲管理層批准，才可停止指定EDD；須記錄理由。
rows.en: Only cease prescribed EDD after appropriate assessment finds no remaining high risk and senior approval; retain reasons.

refs.anchor: a spouse or a partner of a child
not merely on prescribed time limits

note.tc: PEP範圍亦包括適用家庭成員及密切聯繫者；中／初級人員不因一般職位便成為PEP。
note.en: PEP scope also includes applicable family and close associates; ordinary middle/junior roles do not themselves qualify.

rows.en: The intermediary usually has an existing independent customer relationship/procedures.
